rights.rationale: Upstream repository publishes the model under Apache-2.0 (machine-readable `license: apache-2.0` metadata in README/model card and HF model tags). Apache-2.0 grants personal/commercial use, modification, fine-tuning, quantization/conversion, and derivative redistribution with notice preservation. CAVEAT: no standalone LICENSE text file exists in the pinned repository tree; the declaration is carried by README front matter and HF license tags at the pinned revision. Exact pinned-revision URLs are cited as terms evidence. Any weight-access task MUST re-verify current terms immediately before acquisition (FR-018/T021 landscape rescan also re-checks this). Component rights (FR-016): tokenizer files and any vision-encoder weights ship inside the same pinned repository tree and are covered by the identical declared license verified at the pinned revision; no third-party component with independent terms is used. Any weight-access task must re-verify all components at acquisition time.
